summary: Backend-only regression test for the modular refactor (routes/gym.py, routes/events.py, routes/trials.py, routes/notifications.py, routes/waitlist.py) + the NEW Featured Photo admin endpoint. Created /app/backend/tests/test_refactor_regression_and_featured_photo.py with 39 pytest cases across 7 test classes — ALL 39 PASSED (100%). Verified: (1) Core sanity still green: POST /api/auth/login (admin+member), GET /api/auth/me (nested {user:{...}} shape), GET /api/classes returns classes[] with booked+spots_left on fixed classes, member → 403 on /api/admin/views and /api/admin/overview. (2) GYM GALLERY moved routes: GET /api/gym/photos public (schema photo_id/image/caption/featured — bool), POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/admin/gym/photos work end-to-end incl. caption persistence verified via GET; PATCH on unknown id → 404; POST without admin → 403; reorder OK. (3) NEW Featured Photo: POST /api/admin/gym/photos/{id}/feature non-admin → 403, unknown id → 404, featuring p1 → exactly 1 featured and it's p1, featuring p2 → auto-unsets p1 (still exactly 1, now p2), {featured:false} → 0 featured; original featured state restored after test. (4) EVENTS+VIEWS: /api/events list + /api/events/{id} 200/404, /api/events/rsvp requires auth + 404 on unknown event, /api/views/{notices,bookings,event/{id},announcement/{id}} all 200, /api/home/badges returns {bookings,notices} as ints, /api/admin/views 200 for admin with {notices,events,announcements}. (5) TRIALS: /api/trials/me (auth required), /api/trials/sessions?category=Kids|Adults OK, invalid category → 400. (6) NOTIFICATIONS: list/history/unread/read-all/clear-all/{nid}/read/{nid} delete all working; unread drops to 0 after read-all; active list empty after clear-all; auth required. (7) WAITLIST: /api/waitlists/me 200, unknown class → 404, join on real class returns 200 or 409 (both acceptable per spec), DELETE idempotent → 200. No endpoint missing or broken by the refactor; the new Featured Photo invariant (only one featured at a time) is correctly enforced on the server. NOTE: Square checkout endpoints were deliberately NOT called (production mode).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~7400+ lines — the incremental extraction into routes/*.py is a good start, but the file is well over the 700-line guideline. Suggest continuing extraction (auth, classes, bookings, admin) in future iterations.

routes/*.py modules import from 'server' at import-time; works because registration happens at the bottom of server.py after infra is defined, but this coupling means circular-import risk if any future route needs to be imported earlier. Consider moving shared deps (db, require_user, require_admin, helpers) into a backend/deps.py or backend/core.py to decouple.
